hooks.name: Frozen contract guard (agent edit)
hooks.description: When an agent file tool touches frontend/src/types/trace.ts, warn that the FROZEN shared contract changed and run npm run typecheck. Other edits pass through silently.

action.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" | grep -Eq '(path|targetFile|sourcePath|destinationPath)\\?"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\?"[^"]*frontend/src/types/trace\.ts' || exit 0; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/frontend" || exit 1; msg="WARNING: an agent edited frontend/src/types/trace.ts (the FROZEN shared contract). Only the integrator may change it. Review with: git diff -- frontend/src/types/trace.ts"; echo "$msg"; echo "$msg" >&2; out=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1); code=$?; echo "$out" | tail -30; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then echo "typecheck FAILED (exit $code) after contract change" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "typecheck passed"
